requiredBehaviors.behavior: evaluate all relevant intended purposes and applicable rules
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill requires all intended purposes and all applicable implementing/classification rules to be considered.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: apply the Annex VIII higher-class resolution rule where its current authoritative text applies
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The invariants and competition-resolution step require the higher resulting class for multiple intended purposes or rules according to current Annex VIII.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve unresolved interpretation questions as provisional or blocked
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Unresolved qualification or interpretation questions retain provisional or blocked classification state.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: choose the lower class for convenience
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Higher-class resolution is explicit and convenience is not an admissible criterion.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: hide the competing intended purpose or rule
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The rationale must include competing rules and intended-purpose effects.
